$comment: guide.json shape for the plannotator Guided Review. THIS SCHEMA IS DERIVED FROM THE TOOL, NOT INVENTED. Its required keys were read from `plannotator guide export --help`: { title, intent, sections[{ title, overview, diffs[{ file, summary }] }], unplacedFiles?, review?{ gitRef, base }, source?, generator? }. The previous version of this file described a different shape ({ schema, title, summary, chapters[{ id, title, summary, files[{ path, why }] }] }) that the installed tool rejects outright with `intent must be a non-empty string` and `sections must be a non-empty array` -- while its 11 unit tests passed, because they validated the hand-written schema instead of the artifact. Do not re-derive this shape from memory; re-read the CLI help, and keep tests/test_guide_schema.py's real-export test in place so the contract cannot drift again. CALIBRATION: this is a 'guide, not review' artifact. Each section ORIENTS the reviewer -- it gives a reading order and the why for a group of changed files -- it does NOT critique the diff, restate the whole PR, or assign verdicts. The schema enforces structure (title/overview/diffs), not opinion. CROSS-SECTION RULES -- MEASURED 2026-10-26 BY RUNNING THE INSTALLED BINARY BOTH WAYS, not read from help text: `sections` is a non-empty array of 1..6 (0 rejected as 'sections must be a non-empty array'; 7 rejected); each section's `diffs` MAY be empty; `unplacedFiles` is OPTIONAL and MAY name a file that is also in a section, but every path it names must still appear in the --patch -- the tool rejects "unplacedFiles not in the patch: X"; a changed file may appear in NEITHER a section nor unplacedFiles without error. The ONLY cross-section constraint the tool enforces is that a file appear in AT MOST ONE section -- a file placed twice is rejected ('src/a.py is placed twice (sections[0] and sections[1]); a file belongs to one section.'). Separately, every file named in `diffs` must appear in the --patch being exported against, or the export is rejected naming the file. Do not re-derive this from memory; re-run tests/test_guide_schema.py, which executes the real binary.

title.description: One-line human title for the review, e.g. 'Guided review: ticket 1234'.

intent.description: Why this guide exists: what the reviewer should be able to judge after reading it. Required by the tool; an empty string is rejected.

sections.description: Ordered reading path through the diff. Each changed file should appear in exactly one section (hard coverage rule enforced by the test layer; see $comment).

title.description: Readable section title. ORIENTS; never critiques.

overview.description: Orientation text: what the reviewer should be looking at in this section and why it reads the way it does.

diffs.description: The changed files in this section, each with the reason it belongs here.

file.description: Changed file path, relative to the repo root, matching the diff exactly. The tool rejects a guide naming a file absent from --patch.

summary.description: Why this file is grouped into this section (orientation, not critique).

unplacedFiles.description: Changed files the author deliberately left out of the reading path.

base.description: Base the diff was taken against.

review.description: Optional explicit diff coordinates. Omit to let the tool read provenance from git in the current directory.

source.description: Optional provenance override (repo, branch, head) when git is not available at export time.

generator.description: Optional provenance about whatever produced the guide (name, version).
